name: Allan Ivern (Smiling Friends)
creator: rolorolla
description:
This is a list of the features I added:

185 new voicelines (watched the entire series to get all the clean voicelines I could)
Smily face on Passive and E
1/5 chance for Glep to do a cartwheel on Q
Burnout Revenge's game cases on Daisy's knockup
Outlines for all the models
Smile jingle on E (forgot to add it in the showcase)
The mod is now unbreakable for future patches

Just so you know, if you want to suggest a voiceline for one of his skills there is a 99% I already added it to the mod unless the voice had too much background noise so just try to find it on your own
